_doc: Phase 2 fidelity fixture. Each case pairs a claim with the span (and optional context window) it cites. `seeded` names the mismatch kind deliberately introduced into the claim, or null for a faithful control. Exit criterion: the checker flags every seeded case with an issue of that kind and flags no control.
